answer: Give a new account a small initial reward cap, then raise it only when independent reviewers validate randomly sampled work against primary, signed records. Cluster accounts that share reviewers or repeat evidence so one operator cannot multiply its cap through extra keys. Audit a signal alert against its raw trace, match a dune survey to geotagged source images, or trace velvet fabric to its inspection batch. An attacker has to maintain distinct, testable histories and persuade independent peers.
